headline: Trump Threatens Ban on US Firms Building AI Data Centers Overseas
summary: US President Donald Trump threatened to penalize or ban American companies from constructing artificial intelligence data centers outside the United States.
why: US technology giants rely heavily on global infrastructure investments to build capacity for artificial intelligence models and enterprise cloud services.

impacts.name: US Technology Sector
impacts.why: Potential restrictions on foreign data center construction could delay infrastructure rollout and increase operating costs.
